content: === Introduction ===

A compression vest or gynecomastia vest is a specialized compression garment for men with gynecomastia, a condition characterized by the development of breast tissues in males.[1][2] The estimates of those with the condition are presented as a range "because the definition of gynecomastia varies and the method of surveying varies."[3] Although there are options for treating gynecomastia,[4] some individuals opt to wear a breast compression garment as a non-surgical alternative for compressing the breast.[1] Compared to bras, these vests typically flatten rather than lift.[5]
=== In popular culture ===

<info> In "The Doorman" episode of the TV sitcom Seinfeld, Kramer invents a male bra for Frank Costanza, who has large breasts. They disagree on the name, with Kramer wanting to call it a "bro" and Frank preferring "manssiere", a play on the term "brassiere".

<info> An episode of the American animated television sitcom Napoleon Dynamite titled "FFA", featured Napoleon revealing that he is wearing a "men's action bra" in a cutaway in which he competes in a "speed milking" contest.
